name: rotationXAxis
description: Rotation angle around X axis in radians

name: rotationYAxis
description: Rotation angle around Y axis in radians

name: rotationZAxis
description: Rotation angle around Z axis in radians

name: referenceOrientation
description: Rotation angle for the system relative to true north

name: timeStamp
description: Timestamp for which the rotation applies.

name: orientationType
description: Rotation coordinate system. See header info in documentation.

name: referenceOrientValid
description: Set to 1 if referenceOrientation valid otherwise set as 0.

name: rotationApplied
description: Set to 1 if rotation around XYZ axes (first three fields) already applied otherwise set as 0.

name: rotationNorthApplied
description: Set to 1 if values in traces already rotated to true north. Otherwise 0.

name: headerBlockType
description: Must be 60 (hex) or 96 (decimal) for sensor info header.
